nodes.body:
## Pull request overview This PR enables and rewrites `dma_coherent` to add a Verus-style coherent DMA mapping implementation parallel to `dma_stream`. **Changes:** - Enables the `dma_coherent` module. - Replaces the prior `DmaCoherent` implementation with a generic `RwArc`/tracked-owner based implementation. - Adds `VmIo`, `VmIoOnce`, address accessors, and reader/writer helpers for coherent DMA mappings. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `ostd/src/mm/dma/mod.rs` | Enables the `dma_coherent` submodule. | | `ostd/src/mm/dma/dma_coherent.rs` | Reimplements coherent DMA mapping with verified ownership structures and VM I/O support. |
Comments suppressed due to low confidence (3) **ostd/src/mm/dma/dma_coherent.rs:115** * The direct-DMA path no longer shares the GPA range with the host for TDX/CVM guests. On those configurations the device will be given addresses for private pages it cannot access; please restore the conditional `unprotect_gpa_range`/matching protect-on-drop behavior or return an error when that hook is unavailable. ``` let start_daddr = match dma_type() { DmaType::Direct => { // TODO: restore TDX GPA sharing once the arch hook is verified. start_paddr as Daddr }, ``` **ostd/src/mm/dma/dma_coherent.rs:134** * The IOMMU branch iterates over frames but never installs any IOMMU mappings before returning the physical address as the device address. When DMA remapping is enabled, the device will not be able to access this buffer; please call the IOMMU map operation for each frame (and add corresponding unmap cleanup) or reject coherent DMA under IOMMU until supported. ``` while i < frame_count { let _paddr = start_paddr + i * PAGE_SIZE; // TODO: restore iommu::map once the IOMMU API is verified. i += 1; } start_paddr as Daddr ``` **ostd/src/mm/dma/dma_coherent.rs:145** * This allocates a DMA mapping but the new `RwArc`-backed inner type has no `Drop` cleanup to undo it. As a result, any inserted mapping state, IOMMU entries, TDX sharing, and cache-policy changes cannot be released when the last clone is dropped; please add a drop path on the inner allocation that mirrors all setup done in `map`. ``` let inner = RwArc::new(AtomicDataWithOwner::new( DmaCoherentInner { segment, start_daddr, is_cache_coherent }, Tracked(inner_owner), )); Ok(DmaCoherent { inner }) ```

nodes.bodyHTML:
Pull request overview

This PR enables and rewrites dma_coherent to add a Verus-style coherent DMA mapping implementation parallel to dma_stream.

Changes:

  • Enables the dma_coherent module.
  • Replaces the prior DmaCoherent implementation with a generic RwArc/tracked-owner based implementation.
  • Adds VmIo, VmIoOnce, address accessors, and reader/writer helpers for coherent DMA mappings.

Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

File Description
ostd/src/mm/dma/mod.rs Enables the dma_coherent submodule.
ostd/src/mm/dma/dma_coherent.rs Reimplements coherent DMA mapping with verified ownership structures and VM I/O support.
Comments suppressed due to low confidence (3)

ostd/src/mm/dma/dma_coherent.rs:115

  • The direct-DMA path no longer shares the GPA range with the host for TDX/CVM guests. On those configurations the device will be given addresses for private pages it cannot access; please restore the conditional unprotect_gpa_range/matching protect-on-drop behavior or return an error when that hook is unavailable.
        let start_daddr = match dma_type() {
            DmaType::Direct => {
                // TODO: restore TDX GPA sharing once the arch hook is verified.
                start_paddr as Daddr
            },

ostd/src/mm/dma/dma_coherent.rs:134

  • The IOMMU branch iterates over frames but never installs any IOMMU mappings before returning the physical address as the device address. When DMA remapping is enabled, the device will not be able to access this buffer; please call the IOMMU map operation for each frame (and add corresponding unmap cleanup) or reject coherent DMA under IOMMU until supported.
                while i < frame_count {
                    let _paddr = start_paddr + i * PAGE_SIZE;
                    // TODO: restore iommu::map once the IOMMU API is verified.
                    i += 1;
                }

                start_paddr as Daddr

ostd/src/mm/dma/dma_coherent.rs:145

  • This allocates a DMA mapping but the new RwArc-backed inner type has no Drop cleanup to undo it. As a result, any inserted mapping state, IOMMU entries, TDX sharing, and cache-policy changes cannot be released when the last clone is dropped; please add a drop path on the inner allocation that mirrors all setup done in map.
        let inner = RwArc::new(AtomicDataWithOwner::new(
            DmaCoherentInner { segment, start_daddr, is_cache_coherent },
            Tracked(inner_owner),
        ));

        Ok(DmaCoherent { inner })

review_comments.body:
The `is_cache_coherent` flag is now only stored and never acted on. For non-cache-coherent devices, `map(..., false)` no longer switches the linear mapping to uncacheable (nor restores it later), so CPU/device views can become incoherent; please keep the previous cache-policy transition or fail this mapping mode until it is implemented.

This issue also appears in the following locations of the same file:
- line 111
- line 128
- line 140

review_comments.body: Enabling the submodule alone does not make `DmaCoherent` available to callers of `mm::dma`; the active module does not re-export it (the previous `pub use dma_coherent::DmaCoherent` is still inside the commented-out legacy block). Add an active `pub use` if this PR is meant to introduce the coherent DMA API.
